en: The image shows the reverse side of a vintage German postcard. On the left is a printed sender/imprint block for a Berlin bookstore and publishing house, with a small logo of a person standing at a lectern. On the right is the standard postcard layout with the word "Postkarte", faint postal cancellation marks where a stamp would be, and typed address lines to an archaeological/antiquities society in Pernau, Estonia.
